title: Asset manifest — config/asset-manifest.json
description: Inventory of every visual, audio, and font asset the game needs: what it is for, where the file lives, device variants, full generation provenance, and pipeline status. Every entry here must be covered by prompts/art-prompts.json or prompts/audio-prompts.json, and every generated file must trace back to an entry.

assets.description: All assets, unique by assetId (uniqueness enforced by the config validator).

assetId.description: Asset id with kind prefix per CONVENTIONS §10, e.g. img.symbol.h1, audio.music.base, font.hud-numerals.

filePath.description: File path relative to games/<slug>/assets/ using forward slashes.

resolution.description: Pixel dimensions of the delivered file.

purpose.description: What this asset is used for in the game, e.g. 'H1 premium symbol, base and feature reels'.

file.description: Primary delivered file (png is the source of truth for art).

format.description: File format of the primary file.

resolution.description: Pixel dimensions. Required for image assets; omit for audio and fonts (enforced by the config validator).

transparent.description: Whether the image carries (or must carry after keying) an alpha channel. Always false for audio/fonts. Magenta-keyed generations must be cleaned before status 'cleaned'.

atlasGroup.description: Kebab-case id of the texture atlas this asset is packed into, or null for standalone files (backgrounds, audio, fonts).

deviceVariants.description: Alternate files for specific device profiles. Empty array when the primary file serves all devices.

deviceProfile.description: Id of a profile in config/device-profiles.json, e.g. 'mobile-low'.

provenance.description: Where this asset came from. Required for certification honesty and IP review.

generator.description: Tool/path that produced the asset: image-gen MCP tools, a Blender script, hand-made, or an external source.

prompt.description: Full generation prompt (imagegen-mcp) or a pointer to the Blender script parameters.

seed.description: Generation seed when the tool exposes one (integer, or a tool-specific string).

model.description: Model/tool version that generated the asset, e.g. 'gpt-image-2'.

sourceFiles.description: Input files this asset was derived from (raw generations, Blender scenes, edit sources). Empty for from-scratch generations.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the current file was produced.

license.description: License/usage note, e.g. 'generated in-run via imagegen MCP; original work, no third-party IP'. External assets must name the license.

status.description: Pipeline stage: prompt written but not generated; raw generation on disk; keyed/cleaned; packed into an atlas; final and referenced by the client.
